[1] about.md > Second Light
## Lights for Scouts

Since 2019 we have donated 2,400 lanterns to scout troops across Maryland through Lights for
Scouts. Each spring, troops apply through their council and receive Firefly 220 lanterns for
their summer camps, along with a repair clinic run by the Repair Center. Dale Whitcomb, who
started repairing scout lanterns before the company existed, still attends the Frederick clinic.
Customers can add a lantern to the program at checkout for $25, and the company matches every
donated lantern one for one.

## Second Light

Lanterns that come back as returns or trade-ins and pass a bench inspection are sold as Second
Light refurbished items, at a discount, with a 1-year warranty. Second Light items are sold at
both showrooms and, a few times a year, online. The program keeps good lanterns out of landfills
and gives a scout troop or a student a Sentinel at a Firefly price.

## The company

Lantern Supply Co. is a Maryland corporation, privately held and family owned. The fiscal year
runs from February 1 to January 31. The company has no outside investors and no debt beyond the
mortgage on the Hagerstown building.

[2] employee-handbook.md > Employee discount
### Other benefits

Full-time employees receive a company-paid life insurance policy of $25,000, a pretax commuter
benefit of up to $150 a month, and an annual stipend of $200 for work boots or safety footwear for
warehouse and repair staff. The company pays for the ServSafe-style fuel handling certification
required for warehouse staff and renews it every three years.

## Employee discount

Every employee, full-time or part-time, gets 30% off the retail price of anything we sell, in the
showrooms or on the online store, and 50% off Second Light refurbished items. The discount applies
to merchandise, not to shipping, repairs or gift cards. Employees may spend up to $2,000 a year at
the discounted price; purchases past the cap are at retail. The cap resets on January 1.

The discount is for you and the people in your household. Buying discounted items to resell, or
for friends outside your household, is a conduct violation and ends the discount. Use the
discount code on your employee ID card online, or give your employee number at the register. Your
discounted purchases still earn Lumen Rewards points on the amount you actually paid.

## Dress code

Showroom and support staff wear the lantern green polo (we provide three) with your name tag,
with dark trousers, jeans without holes, or a knee-length skirt, and closed-toe shoes. Warehouse
and repair staff wear the grey Lantern Supply Co. work shirt, long trousers and steel-toe or
composite-toe boots; the boot stipend above covers them. Hats are fine in the warehouse, not in
the showrooms. Replacement polos and name tags come from Beth Carrow; a replacement name tag
takes about a week.

[3] faq.md > Do you sell refurbished lanterns?
### How do I replace a broken Beacon 600 globe?

Order globe G-600 for $14.99. Unscrew the top cap, lift the old globe off the posts, set the new
one in place and screw the cap back on; it takes about two minutes and no tools. Keep the rubber
gasket under the cap, as a new globe does not come with one.

### Do you sell refurbished lanterns?

Yes. Lanterns that come back and pass a bench inspection at the Repair Center are sold as Second
Light refurbished items at a discount, with a 1-year warranty. They are sold at both showrooms
and a few times a year online.

## Bundles

### Base Camp Bundle — $199.99

One Sentinel 1000 and two Firefly 220 lanterns in one box, for a household that wants one big
light for the main room and two small ones for bedrooms. Bought separately the three lanterns
cost $219.97, so the bundle saves $19.98. The Firefly 220s come in slate. Each lantern carries its
own warranty: 5 years on the Sentinel, 2 years on each Firefly. A bundle can be returned only as a
whole; one lantern from a bundle cannot be returned on its own.

## Ordering and availability

Every item in this catalogue is stocked at the Hagerstown warehouse and ships from there. The
showrooms carry the full LED line, the Hagerstown Kerosene Lantern and the Heritage No. 7 on the
floor; the Northstar and the Sentinel 1000 Pro are kept in the back room and brought out on
request. An item shown as backordered on the online store ships in the order the orders were
placed, and the order confirmation gives the expected ship date. We do not charge a card until
the item ships.

## What we believe

A lantern should last. Everything we sell is chosen or built to be repaired, and the Repair
Center will fix an out-of-warranty lantern at a fair price rather than tell you to buy a new one.
A policy should be plain. Our returns, shipping and warranty pages say what we do in numbers,
and the customer service team is allowed to say yes. A customer should be able to reach a person.
The phone is answered by someone in Frederick, Monday through Friday 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM and
Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern.
